# 🎯 Customer Success Plan Template

**Document Type:** Template
**Category:** Customer Success Planning
**Owner:** Assigned CSM
**Version:** 1.0
**Last Updated:** August 2026

---

## Purpose

A Customer Success Plan aligns the CSM, the customer, and internal stakeholders on the outcomes the customer is trying to achieve, and how VBS will help them get there. It should be created during onboarding and reviewed at every Business Review.
